name: ZX_TRX_PRE_PROC_OPTIONS_GT
description: This is a temporary table which is used internally by Oracle.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Internal organization identifier of the transaction

columns.name: PROD_FAMILY_GRP_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the product family of this event class. Possible values are P2P and O2C

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application Identifier of the transaction

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the application event class for the transaction

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Primary transaction identifier

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code

columns.name: PARTNER_PROCESSING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the purpose for which tax service provider is called. Possible values are C (Calculate), F (First Time Calculation), S (Synchronize)

columns.name: TAX_PROVIDER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the third party service provider that has determined the tax on this summary line. Null if there is no third party service provider integration for the tax.

columns.name: EVNT_CLS_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Event class mapping identifier

columns.name: TAX_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Tax event type code of the transaction

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific event that triggers call to a tax processing API. This value will be stamped on all transaction lines passed as input during that API call.

columns.name: QUOTE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether transaction is passed as quote to the tax service provider

columns.name: RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax lines for this event class are recorded in the tax repository

columns.name: RECORD_FOR_PARTNERS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this event class is recorded in repositories of external service providers

columns.name: APPLICATION_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_NUMBER
columns.description: Legal Entity number

columns.name: ESTABLISHMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Establishment number

columns.name: ALLOW_TAX_CALCULATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax provider service should calculate tax for the transaction passed to it.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
